g.text: (a) Alveolar gas equation with 100 % O₂, water vapour 6.3 kPa, CO₂ 5.3 kPa. (b) Collapse moment of an inflated fabric tube, M = π p r³; real joints use pleats, bearings
and constant-volume shapes to cut this by a large factor. Dotted lines: suit pressures of panel (a).
